messages.text:
"Create a code structure and game design document for a 2D web-based visual novel / simulation game titled \"Girlfriend Care Simulator\".

Core Features:
1. Main Menu: Start Game button.
2. Character Screen: Display an anime-style girlfriend character with prominent physical attributes. Include an interactive wardrobe system where the player can click buttons to change her clothes/outfits (e.g., Casual, Lingerie, Cosplay, Office Wear).
3. Activity Menu: A dashboard with clickable options/buttons on the screen to interact with her. Options should include:
   - Talk / Chat
   - Feed / Snack Time
   - Hug / Cuddle
   - Play a Minigame / Tease
4. Stats System: Display basic meters for Happiness, Affection, and Energy that change based on the chosen actions.
5. Tech Stack: Provide the complete, working code in a single HTML file containing HTML, CSS (Tailwind or clean embedded styles), and Vanilla JavaScript so it can be tested instantly in any browser. Keep it clean, functional, and well-structured.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
